func worker(items: [Int], save: (Int) async -> Void) async {
  while true {
    for item in items {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      await save(item)
    }
    break
  }
  while true {
    do {
      for item in items {
        // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
        await save(item)
      }
    }
    break
  }
}

func controls(items: [Int], stop: (Int) async -> Bool) async {
  while true {
    for item in items {
      if await stop(item) { break }
    }
    break
  }
}

func optionalOuter(next: () -> [Int]?, save: (Int) async -> Void) async {
  while let batch = next() {
    for item in batch {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      await save(item)
    }
  }
}

func optionalControl(next: () -> [Int]?, stop: (Int) async -> Bool) async {
  while let batch = next() {
    for item in batch {
      if await stop(item) { break }
    }
    break
  }
}

func empty() async {
  while true {}
  for item in [Int]() {}
}
